plain: A researcher named Matt, speaking on Jesse Michels' podcast, talks about the Serapeum, a set of underground chambers at Saqqara in Egypt that hold huge granite boxes. He says many of these boxes were found blown apart, as if a great surge of energy had passed through them and made them explode. If so, it would hint at some powerful force at work in ancient Egypt.
